name: Kinoki Detox Foot Pads  | Natural Cleansing Foot Patches for Stress Relief & Better Sleep
description:
Relax and refresh your body naturally with Kiyome Kinoki Detox Foot Pads in Pakistan. These pain-free cleansing foot patches are specially designed to support relaxation, stress relief, and overnight wellness care using natural herbal ingredients. Simply apply the pads under your feet before sleeping and let them work overnight. The detox foot pads help promote better sleep, reduce fatigue, relieve stress, and leave you feeling refreshed in the morning. Made with natural ingredients like wood vinegar, tourmaline, pearl powder, and vitamin C, they provide a comfortable and easy self-care experience for men and women. Available in Red & Blueberry variants (randomly shipped), these foot pads are convenient, easy to use, and ideal for everyday relaxation and wellness routines.

Key Features
Natural detox foot pads for overnight use
Helps promote relaxation & stress relief

Easy stick-on application before bedtime
Comfortable non-woven fabric material

Helps reduce tiredness & body fatigue

How to Use
Clean and dry your feet before use
Attach adhesive sheet to the foot pad
Stick the pad under the foot before sleeping
Leave on for 6–8 hours overnight
Remove and discard in the morning
